definitions.explanation: A medicated adhesive patch applied to the skin to relieve pain, reduce inflammation, or treat injuries. In modern Japanese, this most commonly refers to pain-relief patches available at pharmacies. Composed of 湿 (moist) + 布 (cloth).

examples.english: I put a medicated patch on my lower back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{捻挫|ねんざ}→捻挫：05016_nenza⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{湿布|しっぷ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I sprained my ankle, so I got medicated patches from the hospital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷|ひ}やす→冷やす：02403_hiyasu⟧{湿布|しっぷ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{温|あたた}める→温める：02096_atatameru⟧{湿布|しっぷ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: There are cooling patches and warming patches, so please choose according to your symptoms.

notes:
USAGE:
{湿布|しっぷ} in modern usage almost always refers to adhesive medicated patches (like Salonpas). The original meaning was a moist compress or poultice applied to the body.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {湿布|しっぷ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧ (apply a medicated patch)
- {湿布|しっぷ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{剥|は}がす→剥がす：00081_hagasu⟧ (peel off a patch)
- {冷|れい}{湿布|しっぷ} (cold/cooling patch)
- {温|おん}{湿布|しっぷ} (warm/heating patch)
- {湿布薬|しっぷやく} (medicated compress/patch)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Medicated patches are extremely popular in Japan and are available over the counter at pharmacies and convenience stores. They are a common first response for muscle pain, stiffness, and minor injuries.
